ns2:course.label: Graduate Orchestral Conducting
ns2:course.description: Study of conducting techniques and problems related to standard orchestral literature. May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: MUS 333 or equivalent, and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: May be repeated to a maximum of 8 hours. Prerequisite: MUS 333 or equivalent, and consent of instructor.
ns2:course.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Music department.
